cases.label: Config defaults
cases.description: StoreOptions::make() inherits paging and guard configuration. PublicAccess permits this fictional guest example.

cases.label: Fluent settings
cases.description: Offset mode, size 5, and sizes [5, 10] come from immutable fluent options.

cases.label: Attribute settings
cases.description: The same offset declaration uses attributes. Size 7 is retained in [3, 7].

cases.label: Without config defaults
cases.description: The empty baseline supplies guard, offset mode, and size 4 explicitly. The selected size becomes the only allowed size.

cases.label: Keep the selected size
cases.description: Size 6 remains allowed when pageSizeOptions([2, 10]) follows pageSize(6).

cases.label: Selected guard
cases.description: A trusted demo guard supplies a fictional principal. No reader account is signed in or changed.

cases.label: Require a principal
cases.description: publicAccess(false) overrides the inherited public attribute. The dedicated guest guard always returns no principal, so the request fails with access 401.

cases.label: Require a principal with an attribute
cases.description: The PublicAccess(false) attribute requires a principal. The dedicated guest guard produces access 401.
cases.frame: Require a principal with an attribute

cases.label: Allow a public Gate
cases.description: An explicit public source still checks its allow Gate. The Gate receives a fictional catalog argument.

cases.label: Deny a public Gate
cases.description: Public access does not bypass an attached Gate. The deny attribute returns access 403.

cases.label: Ordinary SQLite Eloquent
cases.description: After authorization, this source creates and seeds an isolated in-memory SQLite catalog. No application tables are read.

cases.label: Selected guard attribute
cases.description: The Guard attribute selects the trusted fictional principal and satisfies the required-authentication policy.

cases.label: Fluent overrides attributes
cases.description: An inherited size 7 is overridden by fluent size 10, even though 10 is also the configured default. Uncalled options preserve all other inherited attributes.

cases.label: Raw Collection contract
cases.description: A class can implement CollectionSource directly and return the same fictional rows as an array.

cases.label: Configured required guard
cases.description: This source declares no options or attributes. The documentation application's config selects its dedicated guest guard. Authentication is required by default, so the request returns access 401 regardless of your own sign-in session.

cases.label: Self-contained quickstart
cases.description: The exact overview source returns its fictional catalog without an options contract.
